text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Did you enjoy my race!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Looks like the crowd in the stands was having a blast too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Those sparkling eyes and all that cheering—
they're my greatest treasures in the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Today's victory was all thanks to
everyone's cheers, too...!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I know! I want to do something to thank you!
choice_data_list: The fans are looking forward to the next race too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I know! I want to do something to thank you!
choice_data_list: The fans are looking forward to the next race too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My "victory" is your present...?
Fufu, you certainly know how to make me happy♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Those words... I will keep them close to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Come on, everyone should be waiting outside!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let us make a triumphant return together!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The performance on the grand stage of racing
is far from over—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promise you. No matter how many times it takes,
I will entertain everyone... without fail.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go easy on me again starting tomorrow,
Trainer!"
